dogecoin.text: @TonyVaca3 @barstoolsports I put some money into #dogecoin 2-3 days ago.  I’ve since seen it jump quite a lot over the past few days and while today’s dip was nerve wracking, I’m still currently further ahead than when I started.  It’s rather interesting to watch.

Use #DogeDay as an opportunity to teach yourself or others about market volatility and witness stock actions that move faster than most other stocks do. As of tweeting, one #DogeCoin is about $.31-$.32 each.  If nothing else, you can buy one and just watch what happens.

Y’know, #DogeDay is a good way to get a feel for how stocks work in general.  The whole “Buy Low / Sell High” is easy enough to understand, but actually putting $50-$100 of your own money into #DogeCoin and seeing how it moves is a great way to how it all works.
